text: The purpose of this report is to provide information to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority on a staff initiative to introduce the routine disclosure of financial and senior management expense information. In an effort to improve transparency, accountability and enhance the proactive disclosure of information, the Toronto Parking Authority ("TPA") is making available through routine disclosure, a) corporate financial information; b) information on expenses claimed by the senior management team; and c) compensation information for the senior management team.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (August 8, 2018) from the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority for information.
